citationText: 52 A primary difference between QUAM (NTSC/PAL) and SECAM is that NTSC and PAL color subcarrier signals are both amplitude modulated, whereas SECAM's color subcarrier is frequency modulated, making program conversion more difficult. That may explain why SECAM has jokingly been referred to in the U.S. as “SomEthing Contrary to American Methods.”.
